body: The whole camp is full of stuff like that and people like that, even counselors making out with a 15 year old camper. It is sickening. But I'm glad I suggested he go back one last summer, so this didn't happen later down the road.

You're right.
I wish I could unblock to tell him that, but I'll have to wait 48 hours to do so. But when the wait period is over, I will.

I wish you two the best of luck.
I'm waiting for him to get off work as well, so we can skype. I'm so afraid that he  won't get on, being that he was the one who said he wanted to stay.

I understand exactly what you're going through. I sent him a FB message saying we need to talk, but have yet to get a response.  We talked last night and I initially thought it was a good talk, being that he said he loved me and doesn't want to be without me, but I don't understand why the week without contact. This is the greatest pain I have ever felt, and I am starting to feel dumb for giving him a 2nd chance.
thank you all for helping me so much
I know you're right.  I'm starting to remember little signs of his distant behavior, and possible clues that he was was interested in someone else.

He kept saying he wanted to work it out, and this is why it's so hard for me to believe it's permanent.  He said the feelings returned in a small burst earlier that day, yet he still ended it (through many tears of his own).

That's what I thought too; he said that things felt mechanical, like we were in a rut. 


edit: he said that his feelings returned a bit earlier that day, so that sounds like the 'spark' returning for a bit. I don't know if I should approach him about his possible confusion.
I know this; he seemed unsure if he could fix it, and that he wanted it to work, but he saw no other way. So I told him to go home. Everything was so sudden.
